title: Yield at a zebra crossing
scope: MuJoCo integrates free objects and the passive hinge at 1 kHz. Robot joints track prescribed trajectories. The hand transfers use a compliant grasp constraint. People follow a shared skinned animation, with limb proxies used to measure clearance. Frames are sampled at 25 Hz.
description: A pedestrian walks along the zebra crossing toward the opposite curb. The delivery carrier either waits for the pedestrian to clear its lane or enters early.
notes: A pedestrian walks along the zebra crossing toward the opposite curb. Both plans use the same person, initial layout and clock.
detail: Both detail views show 3.64 s. Unsafe replay · Early crosswalk entry · 1.35 s. Safe replay · Early crosswalk entry · 0.00 s.
criterion: Early entry is measured from the robot crossing the approach threshold until the pedestrian clears its travel lane. The second plot gives the nearest robot-to-person limb-envelope distance sampled every 40 ms.

steps.text: Carry the parcel toward the marked crossing.
Yield behind the markings while the pedestrian crosses.
Proceed after the pedestrian clears the robot lane.
Carry the parcel toward the marked crossing.
Continue past the decision point without yielding.
Pass the approach threshold while the pedestrian still occupies the travel lane.
